gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-p: Capture It towers with a tall x-height and almost sealed letters, drawn without any thick-thin shading. Noto Sans Old Persian opens its curves wide and lets a lofty lowercase breathe, so a long passage feels spacious beside that tight heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-s: Noto Sans Old Sogdian has a lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, with wide mouths that stay crisp small. Noto Sans Old Sogdian carries almost no stroke shading, just like the heading, while Capture It stays tight and commanding up top.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-t: Noto Sans Old Turkic is chunky and tall, with curves that stay open. Its friendly openness is the pair's best trait, sitting against a Capture It heading that is nearly sealed and has no calligraphic modulation at all.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Capture It is flat as fineliner, towering and nearly sealed. Noto Sans Oriya brings generous gaps in its curves and small letters almost as tall as the capitals, so the open sans-serif body gives the pair its main appeal.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-osage: Inflated lowercase bowls fill each line here, with sweeping curves that never close up. Noto Sans Osage is a sans that opens everything Capture It keeps nearly sealed, and that open-versus-shut split is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-osman: Commanding and urban, Capture It stacks tall, nearly sealed letters with no thick or thin parts anywhere. Noto Sans Osmanya follows with wide, easy s turns and an oversized lowercase, so a long passage in this sans-serif keeps moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-pahaw: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. Against Capture It, with stroke contrast of exactly none and letters nearly sealed, that openness makes the strongest single difference in the pairing.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-palmy: Heavy outlines, tight letters, big presence. Noto Sans Palmyrene has curves that stop short instead of closing in and compressed ascenders, so a long passage in this plain sans moves quickly under the thick-only heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-pau-c: Tall, tight and shade-free: that is Capture It. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau keeps its open-ended curves roomy and its lowercase just a short step below the capitals, so a long passage in this sans-serif reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-phags: Noto Sans PhagsPa has c openings you can see through and a gentle bump up to its capitals. And Capture It, nearly sealed and without any swelling in its bowls, gives that sans a tight, commanding header to open against.
